responsibility: Declares the Modula-2-facing terminal-control API implemented by the bootstrap termios wrapper. This generated header defines the opaque termios object handle along with the large enums that map Modula-2 names onto terminal control characters and termios flags, and it publishes the allocation, attribute query/update, baud-rate, raw-mode, drain/flush/flow-control, and per-flag/per-control-character accessor routines that bridge generated GNU Modula-2 code to the host termios subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Unlike Gtermios.cc, which implements the termios bridge with host calls and feature-tested flag/control-character translation, this header is the generated declaration side: it defines the opaque termios handle, the Modula-2-facing enums, and the exported function prototypes.
